title: Bosch 18V Expert Battery 4Ah Twin Pack $349 C&C, + Delivery @ Total Tools
body:
Deal: Bosch 18V Expert Battery 4Ah Twin Pack $349 C&C, + Delivery @ Total Tools

[bargaino] $79 is the ozbargain price for 2x4Ahx18V. $229 gets you a mower included.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/977383
[OZKap] That's like comparing Amazon basics to eneloops
[bargaino] I'm not seeing any real-world specs from Bosch, or naming the cells used.
Ozitio 4Ah have a TMB rating of 50A, so close to the "1000W from fresh full battery" of Bosch.
Ozito 5.2Ah is rated higher, but as for Bosch, they don't give useful real-world numbers.
[furBug] Expert have 2000w max, written on Bosch’s own website.
[OGGazelle] Did you even check my links included you chump
[troyww] Well there was the 2x 8Ah Bosch Core batteries from TKD for $300 but still not " Expert" but "up to" 2000W
[furBug] Ozito don’t have any batteries with tabless cells yet so that’s not apples to apples. The new Einhell Professional do have tabless 4ah pxc, but they’re going to be about $150 a battery too, so similar cost.
[troyww] I was using an adaptor for Ozito to Bosch tools . Ozito battery has a Built in BMS with low voltage cut off bosch has low voltage cut off in each tool .
Got it from ali and it works well , nice and tight . I've used the 5.2A/h Ozito on the Bosch saw and it cuts with a surprising amount of power . Must be impresive with Bosch Biturbo !
[OGGazelle] Best price for enabling biturbo capability - find me a better tab-less 4Ah price.
[Darge] You can usually get a good deal on batteries, or free batteries thrown in about once every 4 months or so. ie. $600 for drill+impact driver + 4 x 8ah batteries.
Or maybe it was just a good year. This year has been a bit average for bosch promotions.
[Bimbobob] How many tools the extra grunt from these batteries? These are basically replacing procore anyway
[OGGazelle] Depends on whether you buy cheapest in line or focus on biturbo - I personally aren’t buying Bosch unless it’s biturbo, or if it’s somehow less than $150 a skin for a cracking deal.
[OGGazelle] @InternetExplorer: Google’s your friend here
[Jianie] thanks for sharing however the price has always been at $349 for ages, only slightly better when there is the point bonus or 10% off . So nothing new really.
**edit, also single battery is going for $199 not $250..
[OGGazelle] Yep understand going for, one of the three merchants have a deal and others have price matched. RRP $250 based on global listings converted.
$349 bargain vs other Bosch batteries, including the core and Procore range.
[Yer] Unless you really need the 4ah form factor, you may as well get a 8ah procore+ for 300$ or 8ah expert for 330$. Cheaper and well better runtime considering these are for high drain tools.
[OGGazelle] Yeah agreed if you were choosing with the intent to only ever buy 2x. I’ve got 2x 8Ah & 2x 5.5Ah, both 1kg per battery though. Got these to have a lightweight option for repetitive tasks, e.g. drilling & impact driving a deck, figure 40% weight saved at the wrist will go well.
